sloka: तत: प्रहृष्टो धर्मात्मा पिता मे मिथिलाधिप: ।अवाप्तो विपुलामृद्धिं मामवाप्य नराधिप: ॥ २.११८.३२॥
transliteration: tata: prahṛṣṭo dharmātmā pitā me mithilādhipa: ।avāpto vipulāmṛddhiṁ māmavāpya narādhipa: ॥ 2.118.32॥

translations.english: Thereafter, my father and the righteous lord of Mithila was delighted in possessing me when a noble thought struck his mind.
